name.text: Finding the side length of a rhombic community garden

questiontext.text:
A community garden features a rhombus-shaped plot for pollinator-friendly plants. The total area of the plot is exactly {@Area@} m². An irrigation line running straight across one of the diagonals measures {@d1@} m.

Calculate the length of one outer side of the plot (\(s\)).

[[jsxgraph width="500px" height="300px"]] var d1 = {#d1#}; var d2 = {#d2#}; var A = {#Area#}; // Half diagonals for drawing var a = d1 / 2; var b = d2 / 2; // Proportional scaling var ratio = 500 / 300; var spanX = Math.max(d1 * 1.3, d2 * 1.3 * ratio); var spanY = spanX / ratio; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [-spanX/2, spanY/2, spanX/2, -spanY/2], maxboundingbox: [-spanX*1.5, spanY*1.5, spanX*1.5, -spanY*1.5], axis: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true, showNavigation: true }); var p1 = board.create('point', [a, 0], {name: '', visible: false}); var p2 = board.create('point', [0, b], {name: '', visible: false}); var p3 = board.create('point', [-a, 0], {name: '', visible: false}); var p4 = board.create('point', [0, -b], {name: '', visible: false}); var center = board.create('point', [0,0], {name: '', visible: false}); // Rhombus Plot board.create('polygon', [p1, p2, p3, p4], { fillColor: '#fff3e0', strokeColor: '#e65100', strokeWidth: 2 }); // Known diagonal (irrigation line) board.create('segment', [p3, p1], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#fb8c00'}); // Unknown diagonal (faint construction line) board.create('segment', [p4, p2], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#ffe0b2'}); // Right angle marker at intersection var rad = Math.min(a, b) * 0.15; board.create('angle', [p1, center, p2], {type: 'square', radius: rad, strokeColor: '#fb8c00', name: ''}); var gapY = spanY * 0.015; var gapX = spanX * 0.015; // Dynamic Labels board.create('text', [a/2, -gapY, "d_1 = " + d1 + " m"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 14}); board.create('text', [a/2 + gapX*2, b/2 + gapY*2, "s = ?"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'bottom', fontSize: 16, strokeColor: '#c62828'}); board.create('text', [0, -b - gapY*4, "Area = " + A + " m²"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 16, strokeColor: '#e65100'}); [[/jsxgraph]]

Side length (\(s\)) = [[input:ans1]] m [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Step 1: Find the length of the missing diagonal (\(d_2\))

The formula for the area of a rhombus is:

\[ \text{Area} = \frac{d_1 \times d_2}{2} \]

Substitute the known values (\(\text{Area} = {@Area@}\) and \(d_1 = {@d1@}\)):

\[ \begin{aligned} {@Area@} &= \frac{{@d1@} \times d_2}{2} \\ {@Area * 2@} &= {@d1@} \times d_2 \\ d_2 &= \frac{{@Area * 2@}}{{@d1@}} \\ d_2 &= {@d2@} \text{ m} \end{aligned} \]

Step 2: Use the diagonal property to find the side length

The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other (cut in half) at right angles, forming four right-angled triangles inside.

  • Half of \(d_1 = \frac{{@d1@}}{2} = {@a@}\text{ m}\)
  • Half of \(d_2 = \frac{{@d2@}}{2} = {@b@}\text{ m}\)

Using Pythagoras’ Theorem on one of these inner right-angled triangles, the side length (\(s\)) is the hypotenuse:

\[ \begin{aligned} s^2 &= ({@a@})^2 + ({@b@})^2 \\ s^2 &= {@a^2@} + {@b^2@} \\ s^2 &= {@a^2 + b^2@} \\ s &= \sqrt{{@a^2 + b^2@}} \\ s &= {@side@} \text{ m} \end{aligned} \]

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text: You calculated the total perimeter of the plot. The question asked for the length of just one side.

node.description: Caught stopping early at missing diagonal

truefeedback.text: You successfully found the length of the missing diagonal (\(d_2\))! But you stopped too early. Use Pythagoras' theorem on half of each diagonal to find the outer side length.

node.description: Caught failing to halve diagonals before Pythagoras

truefeedback.text: You used the full lengths of the diagonals in Pythagoras' theorem. You must divide each diagonal by 2 first, because the right-angled triangles are formed by the halves of the diagonals.
